EmailTemplate.subject: Insperity MarketPlace-Exclusive perks for your employees
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[Client Name],
I hope you’re well. Your partnership with Insperity includes many ancillary benefits including the Insperity MarketPlace.
The MarketPlace, available on Insperity Premier, offers discounts on goods and services with member only pricing on a variety of products.
I have included a message below that you can share with your employees so they can take advantage of these resources. Simply copy the information below the line and paste it into a new email to your employees. I’ve also attached two flyers that you can attach to your email to your employees that will provide them with more information.
Please always feel welcome to reach out to me with questions.
[signature]
Copy and paste the email below for dissemination to your employees; please be sure to remove my name and contact details.
Subject Line: Discount and Deals in the Insperity MarketPlace
You have privileged access to Insperity® MarketPlace™ through our co-employment relationship with Insperity. The MarketPlace offers corporate perks on a variety of goods and services including cell phone discounts, travel and food delivery. You can invite up to five family members and/or friends to join the MarketPlace and take advantage of the deals there.
Frequently asked questions:
• What is Insperity Perks at Work?
You can save money by leveraging the purchasing power of all our members. Enjoy member only pricing on a variety of products and services and earn WOWPoints on every purchase.
• How do I access Insperity Perks at Work?
Access Insperity Perks at Work through the Insperity Premier.
• Can my friends and family use join MarketPlace?
Yes! Once you have registered, you can invite up to five (5) family members and friends to join and benefit from the same significant discounts. To invite family and friends, click the Your Account link at the top of the page and select Invite, or go directly to
https://www.perksatwork.com/myaccount/invitefriend. They will be able
to access the program from any personal computer.
• What are WOWPoints?
WOWPoints are the rewards currency for Insperity Perks at Work. Many offers are designated with a WOWPoints multiplier which rewards double or even triple WOWPoints for every dollar spent. You can redeem WOWPoints at a rate of $1.00 per 100 WOWPoints for cash credit to a linked card. Simply select the "Pay with Points" option under the "Shop Now" button on the offer you would like to redeem them for. Once the merchant confirms your order, the redemption is processed as a cash credit to your linked card.
The MarketPlace is a one-stop shop with member pricing on purchases you’re already likely making.
Get started Log in at Insperity Premier select the MarketPlace icon, complete the registration and start saving now.
For questions on Insperity® MarketPlace™, contact 877-394-7866 or marketplace@insperity.com
